verdict.rationale: Conta Simples is a corporate card and banking platform with a server-to-server REST API. It is not an AI agent or assistant host that would consume tools from external MCP servers, so the MCP-client axis is a category error for this kind of product. Nothing in the evidence shows it ships any agent runtime that could plug in MCP servers; its AI mention (docs-21) covers spend alerts and insights only, and its llms.txt (probe-1) and Markdown pages (docs-19) are documentation formats, not MCP client support.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can plug MCP servers into this product so it can use their tools
